goal: Investigate the current rules.md and create an independent source-driven Node workflow collector, then a complete source-cited Skill in this SAME run. Scope is the explicitly labelled audited acceptance model, never the original synes business. Core/SDK must not change. Call code-map {}, export-snapshot include [rules.md], read-source, import-conventions notes/sourceIds. Inspect output/case/manifest and identity schemas as needed. Use includeIdentityHelper=true, list identity.mjs in artifacts; the helper exports computeEntityId(projectId,kind,orderedSlots), computeRelationId(projectId,kind,from,to,qualifiers), computeEvidenceId(sourceId,hash,start,end,role). orderedSlots are {name,value} objects, never a dictionary. workflowState slots scopeId,workflowId,semanticKey; documentType slots scopeId,semanticKey. Scope comes from configSubset, project ID also; choose one stable workflowId for this document. Implement a SMALL text grammar for documented lines STATE -> STATE: trigger, guard. Recompute states, edges and exact trigger/guard text from EACH current source; also parse the documented Documents chain and its ordered key names, emitting documentType entities and relates_document edges with qualifiers.orderedKeys as those names. Preserve the source words rather than interpreting code. Use declared/static assertions with actual UTF-8 evidence. Do not turn the conflict variant sentence, logging order or /help into transitions. This collector need not parse TS/SQL or invent router or column bindings. Handle empty input/deleted source as successful empty replacement; never hard-code states/paths/conditions as output. Coverage capability workflow, sourceSetId from the input sourceSets, complete for the supported current declarations; sources missing should yield empty output. One extract stage with rules.md selector and at least one meaningful case requiring real computed entity IDs and a real relation ID. Case input is the exact exported CollectorInput with pluginId/version/stageId adjusted to the manifest. Write manifest, collector, case and input in a bundle, validate-plugin, repair only structured errors within budget. After activation CONTINUE export-topic-context topicId=purchase-workflow query=purchase view=workflow maxChars=80000. Import a concise TopicArtifact preserving the returned metadata and ALL gaps. Each explanatory line has [[claim:id]], original evidenceIds from context.sourceReferences. Use basis=declared,origin=static for original document claims; no AI-inferred claims without required gaps. Then export-skill name=purchase-workflow. Do not stop at activation; finish only with a fresh complete Skill.

investigation.notes:
Investigation of rules.md (project T19-audited-purchase, scope repo.business, source src_0f7166c8...687fa, contentHash 47228846...5fdc, 1057 bytes, lines 1-16):

1. Scope identity: configSubset.projectId = "T19-audited-purchase"; only declared scope is "repo.business" (get-capabilities.scopeIds). Repository id = "business". No services/dataSources/bindings are declared in configSubset, so no identityDelta is registered; this collector must not invent service or column bindings.

2. Documented line grammar (observed, rules.md lines 6-11): each transition line matches `UPPER -> UPPER: <trigger text>, <guard text>` — a left-hand state name, literal arrow "->", right-hand state name, colon, then trigger phrase up to the first comma, and guard text as the remainder of the line. Exact documented pairs: DRAFT->SUBMITTED (trigger "submit", guard "orderedQty > 0 AND supplierId present."), SUBMITTED->APPROVED ("approve", "role == buyer AND approvalGranted."), SUBMITTED->DRAFT ("reject or withdraw", "applicant == actor for withdraw."), APPROVED->RECEIVING ("receive", "sum(POSTED, not-deleted receipt qty) > 0."), RECEIVING->COMPLETED ("finish", "netReceived >= orderedQty AND all receipts valid."), APPROVED->CANCELLED ("cancel", "netReceived == 0."). Trigger/guard text must be preserved verbatim from the source line (declared basis), never normalized into code predicates.

3. States are the union of LHS/RHS names of those lines (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, RECEIVING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED); workflowState slots = [scopeId, workflowId, semanticKey]; documentType slots = [scopeId, semanticKey]. One stable workflowId chosen for this document: "purchase-acceptance-workflow" (derived from the document title line 1 "Audited acceptance model" and the Documents chain subject "purchase").

4. Documents chain (declared, line 12): `Documents purchase -> receipt -> return use ordered keys tenant_id, purchase_no, line_no.` This yields documentType entities with semanticKey purchase, receipt, return, plus relates_document edges purchase->receipt and receipt->return whose qualifiers.orderedKeys = ["tenant_id","purchase_no","line_no"] exactly as written.

5. Non-transition declarations that MUST NOT become transitions/edges: line 13 UI page ordering (/purchase/approve precedes /Other/purchaseLedger precedes /purchase/receive) is page order only; line 14 explicitly says navigation /help is not a business successor; line 15 says logging-before-saving is only a call order and carries WORKFLOW_EVIDENCE_MISSING; line 16 is a conflict variant sentence about grossReceived vs netReceived (documented conflict, not an edge). No route, request, httpEndpoint, dataTable, dataColumn or dataKey entities may be emitted from these lines.

6. Coverage: capability "workflow"; sourceSetId comes from input.sourceSets[].selectorId (currently "context"); status complete when at least one supported declaration was parsed from a current source; when the selector matches no source (deleted/empty input) the stage must still succeed with empty entities/relations and status "complete" (full project replacement yields nothing). Entities/relations/evidence are recomputed from the current source text of every matching source on each run; no state names, paths or conditions may be hard-coded in the collector.

7. Evidence: UTF-8 byte offsets computed from the decoded source content string; evidence ids via computeEvidenceId(sourceId, contentHash, startByte, endByte, role); entity ids via computeEntityId(projectId, kind, orderedSlots) where orderedSlots is an array of {name,value}; relation ids via computeRelationId(projectId, kind, fromId, toId, qualifiers). projectId/repositoryId come from input.configSubset, not literals.
